rca of the issue: Original bug: get_user_potjes overlaid live_value with dynamic token price for idle/closed pots, so TraderPage's `live_value ?? capital` displayed €10.00 (token-priced) while AnalyticsPage's separate Capital column showed €10.26 (stored capital incl. realized P&L). Fix v13_pot_value_consistency_001 in routes.py ~1552: for CLOSED pots, force live_value = capital (book value); for OPEN pots, keep live_value = mark-to-market. capital_dynamic remains as separate token-priced field for UIs that need it. Verified: closed pots now show 10.15/10.26 in both TraderPage and API responses; open pot-006 keeps its MtM value distinct.
